independence: fresh contexts, no shared reasoning or reviews; shared filesystem is not OS isolation
consensus: At least 2/3 materially exact structured agreement: set equality after whitespace-only normalization; no text similarity; confidence and ambiguity preserved. Invalid responses do not establish direct consensus.
mandatory_adjudication: All designated 48 plus no clean majority plus any invalid primary. Separate fresh agent receives packets and neutral A/B/C candidates only.
repairs: At most one schema-only enum repair; originals retained; no semantic evidence retries.
gold_comparison: Only after append-only pre-gold label freeze; authored disputes quarantined, never automatically overwritten.
eligibility: All three effective primary reviews valid, consensus/adjudication valid and unambiguous, no material authored dispute, TRAIN/DEV only in separate machine namespace.

machine_criteria.M04: All required adjudications complete; ambiguous candidates excluded
